defects.description: The project could detect redaction sentinels after reconstruction, but the code-dump reconstruction path itself lacked a fail-closed whole-manifest verifier capable of preventing corrupted/redacted source from being written.
defects.remediation: Added a fail-closed code-dump parser/reconstructor that validates every embedded file SHA-256 and character count before any write, rejects redaction sentinels, duplicate/unsafe paths and incomplete blocks; added regression tests and package commands.
acceptance: actual corrupted Drive code-dump rejected with exit 1 before reconstruction
